description: This PHP source file defines the class UtilityLib within the SuiteCRM\'s API v8 library. It provides methods for user login, logout, and retrieving server info, utilizing other project components such as Paths and AuthenticationController.

classes.name: UtilityLib
classes.description: Provides utility functions such as login, logout, and server info retrieval within the SuiteCRM API v8 library.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Handles user login by invoking the AuthenticationController's login method and retrieving user ID if successful.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Handles user logout by invoking the AuthenticationController's logout method.

methods.name: getServerInfo
methods.description: Returns server information; currently returns an empty array.
